status: Frozen before any test-pool document, question, answer or evidence was downloaded, read or run. Approved by the owner on 2026-11-25 (arms B1, T1 and secondary A1; ceiling USD 2.50; laptop indexing).
use_of_pool: once, for the frozen configurations below, in one reader session; no per-question error analysis; no change to the shipped system after results are seen

population.excluded_development_documents: the 20 documents of E0-E9 (6 dev + 14 held-out)
population.questions: every question of the 111 documents, answerable and unanswerable, no question-level filter; exact count computed by code at load time

index.order: download PDFs (record sha256) -> render -> ColQwen2 page embeddings and BM25/OCR text -> write and commit the index manifest -> only then load questions
index.render: documents.render_page_png profile short768-long1536 (768-px short side, 1536-px long side cap, RGB PNG), byte-deterministic; PNG sha256 recorded; PNGs may be deleted after encoding and re-rendered for reading, refused unless the sha256 matches

visual_model.encoding: notebook 04's two-pass encoding, bitwise equal to the single pass (E5)
visual_model.parity_gate: before any pool page is encoded, re-encode >= 2 development pages and >= 1 development query and require bitwise equality with the frozen E5 cache; otherwise stop

index.text: native text get_text('text', sort=True); full-page Tesseract OCR (eng, 150 dpi) for pages with < 30 native words

B1.retrieval: ColQwen2 MaxSim over every page, top 4 (all pages if fewer)

T1.retrieval: BM25 over native+OCR text, top 4 (all pages if fewer)
T1.role: text-retrieval baseline for the confirmatory contrast

A1.retrieval: if U3 = -(s_1 - s_k)/s_1 >= -0.153079 with k = min(8, pages): read ColQwen2 top 8 (all pages if fewer); otherwise reuse B1's reply. Documents with <= 4 pages never trigger.
A1.role: secondary only; B1 remains the shipped system whatever A1 scores

reader.model: gpt-6-luna (alias; served model and system fingerprint recorded per call)
reader.request_template: system prompt, response_format and message layout byte-identical to the frozen E8 L-B1 requests; parity proven by rebuilding all 118 E8 L-B1 requests from development questions with identical fingerprints

execution.smoke: <= 6 calls on development questions (B1, T1 and 8-page requests), not scored, no pool output; gates as E9 Stage 1
execution.order: per question, a seeded random order of its calls (B1, T1, and the 8-page call when triggered); seed 20261201
execution.fail_closed: append-only log; SDK retries 0, timeout 120 s; at most 2 attempts per index; stop on API error, contract failure, served-model or system-fingerprint change; unknown usage charged at the request's upper bound

scoring.primary: S-v1 (notebook 03 cell f653d232; correct = score > 0), answerable questions
scoring.secondary: S-v2 (notebook 07 b1-scorer-v2) with arm-blind owner adjudication of gray items (optional; never model judgment). Before labels: the exact min/max of each contrast over all consistent labellings.

claims_and_rules.C1_estimate: B1 answerable accuracy with a document-cluster 95% interval, overall and on the core scope (born-digital financial / research report / administration documents); compared descriptively with the development estimate 46/102.

C2_confirmatory.contrast: acc(B1) - acc(T1), answerable, paired by question
C2_confirmatory.visual_retrieval_confirmed: delta > 0 and one-sided bootstrap 5th percentile > 0 and sign-flip p <= 0.05

C3_secondary_A1.a1_gain_supported: one-sided bootstrap 5th percentile > 0 and sign-flip p <= 0.05
C3_secondary_A1.consequence: reported only; the shipped system remains B1

claims_and_rules.statistics: unit = question, cluster = document; percentile bootstrap 10,000 draws (seed 20261202); Monte Carlo sign-flip test 100,000 draws (seed 20261203) on per-document summed differences, one-sided; McNemar descriptive
secondary_metrics: evidence Recall@4 and complete-evidence rate of ColQwen2 vs BM25 (annotations used for scoring only)

ledger: experiments/test_pool_ledger.md is updated at each access step (download, index, question load, run).
